lines.text: Hex: Witches learn a number of magic tricks, called hexes, that grant them powers or weaken foes. At 1st level, a witch gains one hex of her choice. description.value:
Witches learn a number of magic tricks, called hexes, that grant them powers or weaken foes. At 1st level, a witch gains one hex of her choice. She gains an additional hex at 2nd level and for every 2 levels attained after 2nd level, as noted on Table 2–10. A witch cannot select an individual hex more than once.

Unless otherwise noted, using a hex is a standard action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. The save to resist a hex is equal to 10 + 1/2 the witch’s level + the witch’s Intelligence modifier.

classFeatureReview.scheduleRule: Hexes known by witch level = 1 + floor(level / 2): one at 1st and one more at every even level, 11 at 20th (PRD witch.html:415 and Table 2-10 :378-397).

incrementReview.attribution: Each increment has attributionFrom and upstreamKey pf1/GBkIhC1Bpp2MAD4e, pack everythingpath-schedules and detail.parentFeature pf1/GBkIhC1Bpp2MAD4e, so it takes this assessment, holds and notices and is admitted exactly when Hex is (scripts/catalog/admission.ts, isAttributionOwner). No increment has an assessment of its own.
